Results.ReviewText: Love it. Our first one lasted nearly 40 years so we bought another. Purchased the 22" copper kettle. Very pretty! More importantly grills great.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber Kettle, the first purchased @1980. I went away from the Weber Kettle to several gas grills but have come full circle. Nothing else is like charcoal flavor. I have learned much more than I had known about the versatility of the Weber Kettle and don’t see me ever going back to a gas grill.
Results.Title: Full circle Webber Kettle to Weber Kettle

Results.ReviewText: This grill does everything one would expect of a charcoal grill.
Results.Title: No Bad Surprises

Results.ReviewText: Love the green color and it’s built sturdy enough. And of course, it grills like a Weber, which is my personal choice in grills. I only gave it three stars because of the overall scale of the grill — it’s small and short. I just got rid of two old Weber grills that I’ve had for years. Next to those grills this one looks like a play grill for children. Wish it was taller and wider.
Results.Title: Cute But Small and Short

Results.ReviewText: Had my old Webber 40+ years.  Unpacked my new one and there is only one handle on the lower kettle.  Poor redesign!  If you need to lift the grill, one hand will be full of grease where it drips from the cover.  Please put the second bottom handle back on the bottom kettle.
Results.Title: Poor design

Results.ReviewText: We had our first Weber for nearly 40 years and, and with a few replacements, it worked well and never disappointed.
Results.Title: A gift to us - it is a classic!

Results.ReviewText: Still in the learning stage.  So far have done one cook a week -- tip roast, chicken, shrimp, and pork butt today that's still resting.  I added the charcoal baskets to help with the indirect cooking.  Slow cooks have come out great for this beginner.  Waiting to taste test the butt.  My hardest part is balancing temp control and amount of charcoal.
Results.Title: Easy for a beginner.

Results.ReviewText: I am using this grille, along with the extra charcoal-holders, as a smoker, and it has really proven itself excellent! I am glad I bought it!
Results.Title: Excellent smoker

Results.ReviewText: The Weber 22” charcoal grill is simply the best all-around grill, smoker, and roasting appliance there is. With wide array of grills on the market today, I still find it to be one of the best and the one I go back to most often. It’s large enough that you can employ direct or indirect cooking techniques, utilizing a variety of fuel sources, and this thing has more accessories available for it than a Swiss Army knife. In short, if your on the fence….time to get off it and buy the grill. It’s awesome. Just make sure to season it just prior to first use for years of enjoyment!
Results.Title: Versatile, Awesome!

Results.ReviewText: This is the first Webber Grill I've owned.  This grill is awsome.  It holds the heat perfectly just set the dampers and it holds the heat at the temperature you want.   Smoked two racks of ribs the grill held at 250 for 6 hrs no problem.  Wife said these where the best ribs I've ever cooked.
Results.Title: Original Webber Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: Went from a classic 18in round to this beauty. It’s so spacious! Love the extra area to move the done or almost done items over to keep warm. Also got a charcoal rake, which is super helpful in this process. My husband picked out this grill exclusively for the temperature gauge, but we are LIVING for the extra space. One last piece of advice: get the cover. This grill is too gorgeous for the elements.
Results.Title: The extra space! The beauty! The control!

Results.ReviewText: I've already had a warranty issue with my grill top. Weber graciously sent me a new top. I do feel this new model we purchased is not built like they use to be. It isn't completely stable and seems it was made with cheaper materials.
Results.Title: Not as stable as the older ones.

Results.ReviewText:
Love my kettle grill. I had my last grill for 24 years. Never a problem. 
I expect the same thing from this one.
Results.Title: Love grilling

Results.ReviewText: Instructions say “before grilling wait for the coals to get a coating of white ash. However, if you put water soaked hickory or mesquite chips on the coals in order to smoke the meat it will quickly put out the fire. When smoking meats it’s better to not wait until the coals are completely coated in white ashes and drop the water soaked chips on the side coals and leave the the center coals burning hot.
Results.Title: Smoking Meats

Results.ReviewText: Great product. Well constructed.  Does a good job grilling. The hook on the lid is difficult to use.  I bought the aftermarket holder and it works well.  Should have been included with the grill. Otherwise I would give it 5 stars.
Results.Title: Nice grill

Results.ReviewText: I love the grill, the reason for 4 stars is there used to be two handles, now there is one. Cleaning and scraping is more difficult due to this. Cmon Weber, don’t be so cheap.
Results.Title: 4 not 5

Results.ReviewText: 1st time buyer. I have always seen Weber grills being used by others and wondered why so many have them. I now understand! So many ways to cook your favorites and then some. I am mastering indirect cooking and what a difference! Thanks Weber for making me look like a pro!!
Results.Title: 1st time buyer

Results.ReviewText: I recently purchased a pellet grill and was disappointed by the lack of smoke flavor. I went back to the old school way and purchased an original copper kettle Webber. Very happy with the results.
Results.Title: Old school is best.

Results.ReviewText: I received this as a Father's Day gift and love it. I've always used gas grills and talked about experimenting with charcoal. Wow...what a difference! So glad I did.
Results.Title: From gas to charcoal

Results.OriginalProductName: Barbecue au charbon Original Kettle Premium 22 po
Results.ReviewText: Bonne qualité, facile à assembler, fonctionne très bien!
Results.Title: Satisfait

Results.ReviewText: This grill is possibly the easiest grill to cook on that I’ve ever had.  You can maneuver around the grill keeping your hands from direct heat unlike the barrel type grills.  It is also very sturdy.  I watched it get launched across my back yard when an unexpected storm came through.  Not even a dent.  I would definitely recommend this grill
Results.Title: Very sturdy

Results.ReviewText: i own many grills from smokers to griddles,  but webers are my favorite.
Results.Title: A great grill

Results.ReviewText: Exactly what we needed when wanting to BBQ with charcoal.
Results.Title: Perfect

Results.ReviewText: Can’t go wrong with the classic kettle grill by Weber. I love the quality and the additional customer support.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: We have owned this grill twice. It is the best grill on the market imo.
Results.Title: Best Grill

Results.ReviewText: It's a great charcoal grill, the perfect size and the best quality in the grill and all the extra components, worth everything you pay
Results.Title: A great purchase

Results.OriginalProductName: Barbecue au charbon Original Kettle Premium 22 po

Results.ReviewText: Some might find it s bit pricey but it's worth it.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Only a Weber will do! However, I am pretty disappointed in the new 22" Weber. At $240, this grill is much shorter than my old 26" grill, and the top vent doesn't have a plastic grip to protect your hand. Racks seem sturdier, kettle is fine, ash catcher works smoothly. But the rest of it just doesn't warrant the cost. Had to straighten out one leg, which was crushed at the top, to put it together. Asked if Weber could send the plastic grip for the vent and they said no, this model doesn't come with that. Sadly, the quality has declined.
Results.Title: Smaller than you'd think

Results.ReviewText: My hubby loves his new grill.  The lid had a small dent in the edge and Weber replaced it right away.  Very positive customer service experience!
Results.Title: Happy husband.

Results.ReviewText: Very good quality. The set up for the grill was the toughest part. The legs fit into the kettle very snug. You have to use caution because they may bend if forced. For cooking, I find it is very versatile. I’ve slow smoked food, cooked pizza at high temp, and even made cedar plank salmon. My favorite charcoal grill.
Results.Title: Weber Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Easy to assemble. Holds heat great! First time I used charcoal in years, my cook came out great.
Results.Title: Back in Charcoal

Results.ReviewText:
Don't get all the fancy-dancy outdoor stoves. Do it right and get this.

Don fiddle with propane knobs, replace parts, call repair techs. Go with simple and best.

After 18 years of being dragged, beaten, melted and burned, it was time to replace my 22-inch black Weber Kettle. This time I went for the gold, or copper, in this case. The original kettle is the best grill on the market. I am a firm believer that cooking on gas or propane is grilling, but not barbequing. If you're using gas or propane, you may as well do it in the kitchen. I would have brought the wheelless, battered grill with me, but the movers would not allow it in the van.

I subjected my Weber to charred mesquite chunks and branches, oak blocks, and hickory for 18 years. It never saw briquettes. The grill held its own, and the new premium has stepped in to pick up where the old one left off. I am impressed and appreciate the redesigned ash catcher. The thermometer in the lid is an excellent addition. No more holding palms over the fire and counting, "one thousand, two thousand" for very hot, "three thousand, four thousand" for medium, and "five thousand, six thousand" for add more charcoal and wait.

I look forward to another 18 years of use, but this time, I'll ensure the bag of mesquite charcoal isn't too close to the grill to catch fire and melt the tires.

The printed directions were not as clear as they once were. I don't like fussing with my phone to assemble anything. The screen is too small. The use of petroglyphs to cover assembly in all languages needs better drawings or words. 

This is the fifth Weber in my life, and the wheels are the same pain in the neck and frustration to install as they were when I assembled my first Weber in 1972. Some things just haven't improved with age.
Results.Title: The Original Kettle: Great value and performance.

Results.ReviewText: This is my 3rd 22" kettle grill from Weber -- I've given the other two away when I've moved, and acquired new. The construction is the same, and allows a quick extinguish of charcoal when you're done with it -- so you can restart the unused lumps. Classic design allows direct and indirect cooking easily. The newest feature for me is the ash catcher feature, which is nice.
Results.Title: Grill, Close down, Repeat.

Results.ReviewText: wanted a charcoal grill.  Weber has been around for a long time so I knew I would be getting a good product.
Results.Title: Reliable brand

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, no pellets needed, more flavor and just as easy to control temperature as an electric grill with all the “bells and whistles.” I love this grill! I could have saved hundreds if I would have gone in this direction.
Results.Title: Best grill option hands down!

Results.ReviewText: This is the fourth and last Weber Kettle that I have purchased since 1984.  Totally disappointed in the poor quality, sharp edges that sliced open my finger, thinner metal, cheaper finish, etc. my Weber Kettle has gone from the “pride of the patio” to another disposable commodity.
Results.Title: Total disappointment

Results.ReviewText: Weber is the STANDARD for BBQing in the industry. Beautiful grill built to last. I have pellet bust missed the old school grilling that aso rounded me of my youth!
Results.Title: WEBER DOES IT BETTER

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
